test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'behaviour'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• **decorum - **behaviour in keeping with good taste and propriety.
 
• **delivery - **the supply or provision of something.
 
• **presence - **the state or fact of existing, occurring or being present.
 
• **behaviour - **the way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would tie the first sentence with the rest of the passage which talks about how certain conduct by Indians can change the country's perception from the western viewpoint. 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that **behaviour **fits the blank correctly. 
 
• Thus, **option 4 **is the correct answer. 

 

**Correct passage__* - ****Concerned and responsible Indian citizens can encourage sensible consumption (1) __behaviour__. This can be done by shopping less and wasting (2) even lesser; by buying local products to keep the cottage industries and (3) traditional crafts alive. In essence, by valuing their rich (4) heritage and living simple and meaningful lives, Indians can set (5) a precedent and show the west that India is much more than a well of business opportunities.*
